description: The BrokenDev projects (the user's homebrew: VRUN NES demake, Nested VRUN, Nested VRUN enhanced, the SMB1 remake and its Nested version, Super VRUN) built by BrokenDev\brokendev.ps1 into BROKENDEV_HOME\out and run on BrokenNes. The ROMs are built from private source and are never in git: every case skips with a stated reason when its ROM is not there. Record or refresh the expected values with: UAT\run-suite.ps1 -Exe <fresh Workshop> -Filter brokendev- -UpdateGolden.

The ROM is BUILT from the user's own homebrew source (archives under P:\BrokenDev, restored by BrokenDev\brokendev.ps1) and lives outside git, so on a machine without it this case SKIPS.
